name: Kinetic / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A heavy sharp bone break and deep fibrous rip, with one wet compact snap and a couple of dry fragments. Pure kinetic severing, no elemental buzz or ringing.
